name: Detroit Runtz Hash Holes | 1g
description: .85g flower + .15g rosin hand rolled with a custom glass tip. Detroit Runtz has a fruity flavor profile that smells just like a bag of the sugary candy. Enjoy a nice creamy smoke that is smooth and welcoming.
